title: The Cave Picnic
story:
The Ortega family carried a picnic basket up a rocky path. They wanted to eat near the wide mouth of an old cave. Sofia held her little brother's hand on the uneven ground. Her father, Mateo, carried a blanket and a flask of juice. Her mother, Rosa, had packed bread, cheese, and sweet plums. The cave felt cool when they stepped just inside the entrance. They spread the blanket on a flat place in the shade. Birds nested in the cracks above them, but the birds stayed quiet.

Sofia read the information board beside the path. It said visitors could look, but they should not go deep inside. They ate slowly and listened to water dripping in the dark. Then a sudden shower began, and rain hit the dusty ground. The family moved farther into the entrance, where the rock stayed dry. Mateo shone a small flashlight on the nearest wall. Pale marks showed where water had run for many years. Rosa said those marks were not a map and not a message.

When the rain stopped, sunlight returned to the valley. They shook the blanket, packed the basket, and left no rubbish. Sofia looked back once and waved at the quiet cave. On the way down, her brother asked if they could return next month. Rosa said yes, but only with the same careful rules.

quiz.question: What does the word uneven mean in this story?
